# Spectrum News 1

> > Regional 24-hour cable news network delivering local breaking news, weather forecasts, and sports coverage across Ohio, Kentucky, Wisconsin, Massachusetts, and California markets.

Spectrum News 1 operates hyperlocal news channels serving major metros including Cleveland, Cincinnati, Dayton, Louisville, Lexington, Milwaukee, Worcester, and Los Angeles. The network provides comprehensive weather radar, public safety reporting, community features, and sports coverage including NBA playoffs.

## Key Topics

- Local news coverage
- Weather forecasts and alerts
- Cleveland and Northeast Ohio
- Louisville and Lexington Kentucky
- Public safety reporting
- Dayton weather
- Milwaukee Bucks and NBA playoffs
- Ohio news
- Interactive weather radar
- Community stories
- Sports news and basketball
- Closings and delays
- 24-hour news channel
- Regional journalism

## Regional News Hubs

- [Spectrum News 1 | Cleveland](https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/cleveland): Cleveland homepage: breaking news, weather, sports for Northeast Ohio
- [About Us | Spectrum News Kentucky](https://spectrumnews1.com/ky/louisville/about): About Spectrum News Kentucky 24-hour news channel and coverage
- [Public Safety | Cleveland Ohio](https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/cleveland/news/public-safety): Public safety news hub for Cleveland and Northeast Ohio

## Weather & Radar

- [Weather | Dayton Ohio](https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/dayton/weather): Dayton weather forecasts, alerts, and closings from Spectrum News 1
- [Interactive Radar | Spectrum News Louisville](https://spectrumnews1.com/ky/lexington/weather/radar): Interactive weather radar for Lexington and Louisville Kentucky

## Community & Sports Features

- [Ohio Voices | Cincinnati Ohio](https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/cincinnati/news/ohio_voices): Community stories and human interest features from Southern Ohio
- [Hunt For The Title](https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/green-bay/news/hunt-for-the-title): Milwaukee Bucks NBA Eastern Conference Finals playoff coverage

## About & Contact

- [Our Team | Cleveland Ohio](https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/cleveland/about/bios): Staff profiles and journalist bios for Spectrum News 1 Cleveland team
- [Contact Us | Worcester Local News](https://spectrumnews1.com/ma/worcester/about/contact-us): Contact Spectrum News 1 Worcester newsroom with tips and inquiries
